notes.title: CARDS
notes.notes: Everyone wants to get a card with a new game, but it needs your support. The game requires not only your purchases, but also reviews, as well as other activity. In this project, I put a piece of soul and hope that together we can pass the threshold check and I can please you with trading cards.
